pages.text: $(thing)Lysogeny$()$(br2)Some phages do not burst their host at once: they write themselves into its genome and wait. A way to deliver genes. Unlocks cheap Recombinant DNA.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Viruses.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Bacteriophage.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): c cells are infected; a share f of them burst at once, each releasing B phages. Write how many new phages, P, come out.
